_about: The team formats' fighters' own names (RingMode._name_for; the owner, 2026-10-10: 2v2 and 4v4 "Triple AAA": in a 4v4 two fighters of one element could not be told apart by 'the Gale'). A 1v1 keeps the element's competitor name (the Stone, the Tide). Each match draws its names from this list by its seed, none twice; the element shows on the plate beside the name. Short (the plates and the end screen's rows hold about 8 letters at their size), plain letters only (every font of the HUD has them). A mix from round the world (the owner, 2026-10-10: "the names for the bots it doesnt have to be vietnamese"); none a character's of the show, of Smash or of Zelda (Mai and Long dropped: the show has a Mai and a Long Feng). Owner: change the list freely; the Thủy Vân peoples' own names can replace these.
